mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, event_id, event_source, event_version, source_digest, event_digest, event_type, suite_code, object_code, config_key, record_id, aggregate_key, aggregate_sequence, event_payload, delivery_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_owner, lock_time, error_type, delivered_time, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_business_event_outbox current_event WHERE ( (current_event.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( current_event.delivery_status = 'PENDING' OR (current_event.delivery_status = 'FAILED' AND current_event.next_retry_time <= #{now}) )) OR (current_event.delivery_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (current_event.lock_time IS NULL OR current_event.lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_business_event_outbox earlier_event WHERE earlier_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND earlier_event.aggregate_key = current_event.aggregate_key AND earlier_event.aggregate_sequence < current_event.aggregate_sequence AND earlier_event.delivery_status != 'DELIVERED' ) ORDER BY current_event.create_time ASC, current_event.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_event_outbox current_event LEFT JOIN ai_business_event_outbox earlier_event ON earlier_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND earlier_event.aggregate_key = current_event.aggregate_key AND earlier_event.aggregate_sequence < current_event.aggregate_sequence AND earlier_event.delivery_status != 'DELIVERED' SET current_event.delivery_status = 'PROCESSING', current_event.retry_count = current_event.retry_count + 1, current_event.next_retry_time = NULL, current_event.lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, current_event.lock_time = #{now}, current_event.error_type = NULL, current_event.update_time = #{now} WHERE current_event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_event.id = #{id} AND earlier_event.id IS NULL AND current_event.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( (current_event.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( current_event.delivery_status = 'PENDING' OR (current_event.delivery_status = 'FAILED' AND current_event.next_retry_time <= #{now}) )) OR (current_event.delivery_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (current_event.lock_time IS NULL OR current_event.lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) )
